E1.yt_title: You woke up in 1294. What do you do? 🐫 Wrong Century Ep.1 #shorts
E1.yt_description:
Episode 1 — Wrong Century
You fell asleep in 2026. You woke up in a Silk Road caravanserai in Tabriz, 1294 — and a caravan master thinks you're his new guard.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 2 follows the vote.
A = Play the guard · B = Run into the city

📜 History note: Tabriz was the Ilkhanate's great trading hub, where Venetian, Genoese, Armenian and Persian merchants met.

E2a.yt_title: The Khan just invented paper money 💸 Wrong Century Ep.2 #shorts
E2a.yt_description:
Episode 2 — Paper Money
You played the guard. Now the Khan's herald announces paper money — and refusing it is punishable by death.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 3 follows the vote.
A = Spend it now · B = Save it

📜 History note: In September 1294 the Ilkhan Gaykhatu introduced 'chao', paper money copied from Yuan China, in Tabriz. Merchants shut their shops and it was withdrawn within about two months.

E3a.yt_title: Night one on the Silk Road. You have a lighter. 🔥 Wrong Century Ep.3 #shorts
E3a.yt_description:
Episode 3 — Fire
You spent the paper money. Five days east of Tabriz, the wood is wet, a child is freezing — and there's a plastic lighter in your pocket nobody here has ever seen.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 4 follows the vote.
A = Use the lighter · B = Keep the secret

📜 History note: Caravans on this road covered roughly 4–6 farsakhs a day, and in October the Azerbaijan highlands are already cold and wet. Fire was made with flint, steel and tinder.
